test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: What historic milestone did Nat Sciver-Brunt achieve in the Women’s Premier League (WPL) in January 2026?

options.text: She recorded the fastest fifty in WPL history
She scored the highest team total ever in WPL
She became the first player to score a century in WPL history
She became the first player to score a double century in WPL

solution:
The correct answer is __**She became the first player to score a century in WPL history.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Nat Sciver-Brunt scripted history by scoring the first-ever century in the Women’s Premier League during a match between Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bengaluru.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Nat Sciver-Brunt scored an unbeaten 100 off just 57 balls, becoming the first centurion in WPL history.**
 
• Her innings included 16 fours and one six, highlighting her dominance at the crease.
 
• The century came while playing for Mumbai Indians against Royal Challengers Bengaluru in Vadodara.
 
• Her knock helped Mumbai Indians post a formidable total of 199 for 4 in 20 overs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
